question: 单项选择：At 8 last night, I _____ my homework. A. do  B. did  C. was doing  D. am doing
answer: 答案：C. was doing。解析：At 8 last night是过去时间点，"正在做"用过去进行时。

question: 单项选择：This time yesterday, we _____ football. A. play  B. played  C. were playing  D. are playing
answer: 答案：C. were playing。解析：This time yesterday是过去某时，"正在做"用过去进行时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：At that time, she ______ (read) in the library.
answer: 答案：was reading。解析：at that time是过去某时，主语she是第三人称单数。

question: 单项选择：What _____ you _____ this time last Sunday? A. are, doing  B. were, doing  C. did, do  D. was, doing
answer: 答案：B. were, doing。解析：this time last Sunday是过去时间，特殊疑问句用were + 主语 + doing。

question: 翻译句子：昨天晚上这个时候我正在读一本有趣的书。
answer: 答案：I was reading an interesting book at this time last night. 解析：at this time last night是过去某时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：The whole afternoon yesterday, he ______ (work) in the garden.
answer: 答案：was working。解析：the whole afternoon yesterday是过去一段时间，表示持续的动作。

question: 单项选择：I called you at 8 last night, but you _____ in. A. aren't  B. weren't  C. didn't  D. was
answer: 答案：B. weren't。解析：过去时间点8 o'clock，"你不在家"用were not / weren't。

question: 单项选择：At noon yesterday, I _____ lunch with my family. A. have  B. had  C. was having  D. am having
answer: 答案：C. was having。解析：at noon yesterday是过去某时，"正在吃"用过去进行时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：At 7 yesterday evening, we ______ (watch) TV.
answer: 答案：were watching。解析：at 7 yesterday evening是过去时间点，主语we用were。

question: 单项选择：She was cleaning the room _____ her mother came home. A. when  B. while  C. as  D. before
answer: 答案：A. when。解析：when引导一般过去时的句子，主句用过去进行时。
